note_tweet.text:
ChatGPT dots can now pay for things. OpenAI just launched ChatGPT Wallet: you add a card once, your dot does the shopping, and you approve every purchase with Face ID or a fingerprint before it goes through.

The dot never sees your real card number. The card network hands it a payment token instead, and your card's rewards and protections for eligible disputes still apply. It's built with Amex, Mastercard and Visa.

For now it's only for Pro subscribers in the US, 18 and over, with an eligible US-issued card. So no Wallet in Europe yet, and dots themselves are only starting to roll out here.

Approving each purchase is the right way to start. Later on, OpenAI expects to let you hand purchases to your agent entirely, within limits like a spending cap. That's the part I'd want to see a solid track record on first.
